title: Quantum circuit optimization using geometric programming: code, simulation evidence and pre-registered IBM Heron data
description: Research code, tests, simulation evidence, full proofs and pre-registered IBM Quantum hardware records (frozen calibration models, hashed protocols, raw counts and analysis scripts) accompanying the manuscript 'Quantum Circuit Optimization Using Geometric Programming: Exact Convex Co-Design of Gate Timing, Dynamical Decoupling, and Error-Mitigation Budgets'.
